attributes.action: DEMAND ANDY BURNHAM CALL A GENERAL ELECTION AS SOON AS HE IS MADE PRIME MINISTER
attributes.additional_details: THERE IS NO WAY ANDY BURNHAM HAS ANY EXPERIENCE TO RUN OUR COUNTRY.THE PUBLIC NEVER VOTED FOR HIM TO BECOME PRIME MINISTER.LET THE PUBLIC HAVE THEIR SAY.HE HAS USED MAKERFIELD AS A STEPPING STONE.
attributes.background: ANDY BURNHAM HAS NO MANDATE AND NO PATH FOR A SAFER AND FAIRER UNITED KINGDOM.WE DEMAND A GENERAL ELECTION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE WHEN HE IS MADE PRIME MINISTER.THE LABOUR PARTY DEMANDED THE SAME WHEN RISHI SUNAK CAME INTO POWER.THE PEOPLE NEED TO BE LISTENED TO ONCE AND FOR ALL.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
